verses.text: \s1 Isarel milu touk pasueknae
Izip hoi a tâco awh hnukkhu, kum hni nah kum, thapa yung pahni, apasuek hnin vah Sinai kahrawngum kamkhuengnae lukkareiim dawk BAWIPA ni Mosi hah a pato teh,
Isarel tamihu pueng hah a miphun lahoi, a imthung lahoi, a min kâtarui lahoi tongpa pueng koung touk haw,
kum 20 lathueng Isarelnaw thung dawk hoi taran ka tuk thai e naw pueng nang nama hoi Aron ni ahuhu lahoi koung na touk awh han.
Nang koe e miphunnaw pueng thung dawk hoi imthung kahrawikung buet touh koung ao awh han.

Hetnaw heh nang koe kaawm hane tami minnaw doeh.  
 Reuben dawk hoi Shedeur capa Elizur,
Simeon dawk hoi Zurishaddai capa Shelumiel,
Judah dawk hoi Amminadab capa Nahshon,
Issakhar dawk hoi Zuar capa Nethanel,
Zebulun dawk hoi Helon capa Eliab,
Joseph casak Ephraim dawk hoi Ammihud capa Elishama hoi, Manasseh dawk hoi Pedahzur capa Gamaliel,
Benjamin dawk hoi Gideoni capa Abidan,
Dan dawk hoi Ammishaddai capa Ahiezer,
Asher dawk hoi Okran capa Pagiel,
Gad dawk hoi Deuel capa Eliasaph,
Naphtali dawk hoi Enan capa Ahira Enan seh, atipouh.
Hetnaw heh tamimaya thung dawk hoi rawi e a na mintoenaw miphun dawk hoi kahrawikung Isarel imthung kahrawikungnaw doeh.
Hot patetlah Mosi hoi Aron ni min a kaw e hetnaw heh a ceikhai awh.

Tamimaya hah thapa yung pahni, apasuek hnin vah koung a kamkhueng awh teh, a na pa hoi, imthungnaw hoi kakhekungnaw, khetsin lahoi yah, kum 20 lathueng pueng teh kakhekungnaw hah ama buet touh min lahoi a kaw awh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe kâ a poe e patetlah Sinai kahrawngum vah a touk awh.
Isarel capa, a camin Reuben casak thung hoi a min kâtarui lah tongpa pueng kum 20 lathueng tarantuknae koe ka cet thai e,
Reuben miphun a touk awh e teh 46, 500 touh a pha awh.
Simeon casak dawk hoi a miphun lahoi imthungkhu lahoi a min kâtarui e patetlah tongpa pueng kum 20 lathueng tarantuknae koe ka cet thai naw,
Simeon casak a touk awh e naw teh 59, 300 touh a pha.
Gad catounnaw dawk hoi a miphun lahoi a imthungkhu lahoi, a min kâtarui e patetlah tongpa pueng tarantuknae koe ka cet thai naw,
Gad miphun dawk a touk awh e teh 45, 650 touh a pha.
Judah catounnaw dawk hoi a miphun lahoi a imthungkhu lahoi, a min kâtarui e patetlah tongpa pueng kum 20 lathueng tarantuknae koe ka cet thai naw,
Judah miphun dawk a touk awh e teh 74, 600 touh a pha.
Issakhar catounnaw dawk hoi a miphun lahoi a imthungkhu lahoi, a min kâtarui e patetlah tongpa pueng kum 20 lathueng tarantuknae koe ka cet thai naw,
Issakhar miphun dawk a touk awh e teh 54, 400 touh a pha.
Zebulun catounnaw dawk hoi a miphun lahoi a imthungkhu lahoi, a min kâtarui e patetlah tongpa pueng kum 20 lathueng tarantuknae koe ka cet thai naw,
Zebulun miphun dawk a touk awh e teh 57, 400 touh a pha.
Joseph catounnaw dawk hoi Ephraim catoun hai imthungkhu lahoi, a min kâtarui e patetlah tongpa pueng kum 20 lathueng tarantuknae koe ka cet thai naw,
Ephraim miphun dawk a touk awh e teh 40, 500 touh a pha.
Manasseh catounnaw dawk hoi a miphun lahoi a imthungkhu lahoi, a min kâtarui e patetlah tongpa pueng kum 20 lathueng tarantuknae koe ka cet thai naw,
Manasseh miphun dawk a touk awh e teh 32, 200 touh a pha.
Benjamin catounnaw dawk hoi a miphun lahoi a imthungkhu lahoi, a min kâtarui e patetlah tongpa pueng kum 20 lathueng tarantuknae koe ka cet thai naw,
Benjamin miphun dawk a touk awh e teh 35, 400 touh a pha.
Dan catounnaw dawk hoi a miphun lahoi a imthungkhu lahoi, a min kâtarui e patetlah tongpa pueng kum 20 lathueng tarantuknae koe ka cet thai naw,
Asher catounnaw dawk hoi a miphun lahoi a imthungkhu lahoi, a min kâtarui e patetlah tongpa pueng kum 20 lathueng tarantuknae koe ka cet thai naw,
Asher miphun dawk a touk awh e teh 41500 touh a pha.
Naphtali catounnaw dawk hoi a miphun lahoi a imthungkhu lahoi, a min kâtarui e patetlah tongpa pueng kum 20 lathueng tarantuknae koe ka cet thai naw,
Naphtali miphun dawk a touk awh e teh 53, 400 touh a pha.
Hotnaw teh Mosi hoi Aron ni Isarel kahrawikung hlaikahni imthung kahrawikungnaw hai a touk awh e doeh.
Hot patetlah Isarel imthung abuemlahoi kum 20 lathueng taranruknae koe ka cet thai e naw pung Isarel lah koung a touk awh teh,
a touk awh e naw pueng teh 603550 touh a pha.
Hatei, ahnimouh thung dawk hoi Levihnaw kakhekung lah touk awh hoeh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koevah,
Levih miphun teh na touk mahoeh. Isarel taminaw lahai na touksin mahoeh.

Bangkongtetpawiteh, Levihnaw teh lawkpanuesaknae lukkareiim hoi, hnopai khenyawnkung, haw e kaawm e naw pueng ka khenyawnkung lah na pouk awh han. Lukkareiim hoi a hnonaw pueng ka kâkayawt awh teh, ka khetyawt awh han. Bawknae rim a tengpam moi ao sin awh han.
Hote bawknae rim teh a tâcokhai hanlah ao toteh, Levihnaw ni a raphoe vaiteh, hote rim bout a thung awh han. Tami alouke miphun bawk pawiteh thei lah ao han.
Isarelnaw ni amamouh o nah tangkuem koe ahuhu lahoi apap e lahoi lukkareiim teh a sak awh han.
Levihnaw a pâlei teh, kamkhueng e Isarelnaw lathueng vah a lungkhueknae ao hoeh nahan, Cathut onae im a tengpam vah a roe awh vaiteh, Levihnaw ni lawkpanuesaknae bawknae im teh, a khetyawt awh han.
Hot patetlah Isarelnaw ni BAWIPA ni Mosi koe kâ a poe e patetlah a sak awh.
\s1 Miphun lahoi rawinae
BAWIPA ni Mosi hoi Aron a pato teh,
Isarelnaw ni a imthung mitnoutnae koung a vo awh vaiteh, amamae hu lahoi lukkarei rim hah a yap awh han. Kamkhuengnae lukkareiim hmalah koung a kâhmo awh nahanelah, petkâkalup lah a yap awh han.
Kanîtholah hoi kanîloumlah kangvawi sak hoi a imthung mitnout hah a vo awh vaiteh, lukkareiim ka yap kung teh Judah ransahu han doeh. Judah catoun kahrawikungnaw teh Amminadab capa Nahshon han.
A ransahu teh 74, 600 touh a pha.
A hnukthawi lukkareiim kayapkung teh Issakharnaw han. Issakhar catoun kahrawikung teh Zuar capa Nethanel han.
A ransahu teh 54, 400 touh a pha.
A hnukthawi teh Zebulun doeh. Zebulun catoun kahrawikung teh Helon capa Eliab han.
A ransahu teh 51, 400 touh a pha.
A ransahu a pap e lahoi Judahnaw a touk e lahoi 186, 400 touh a pha awh teh, hetnaw heh roenae koehoi ahmaloe a tâco awh han.
Reuben miphunnaw teh akalah ao awh han, a imthung mitnoutnae a vo awh han. Reuben catoun kahrawikung teh Shedeur capa Elizur han.
Hahoi mitnout ka yap hane teh Simeon miphun han. Simeon catoun kahrawikung teh Zurishaddai capa Shelumiel han.
A ransahu teh 59, 300 touh a pha.
Gad miphun doeh. Gad catoun kahrawikung teh Reuel capa Eliasaph han.
A ransahu teh 45, 650 a pha.
Reuben miphun teh a ransahu apap e lahoi, 151, 450 a pha awh. Hetnaw heh a hnuk rekkâbang hane tami lah ao awh.
Hot patetlah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim khue hoi a cei awh han. Levihnaw hah a lungui vah ao awh vaiteh, a onae koehoi kamcunae hmuen koehai a huhu lahoi a cei awh han.
A imthungkhu mitnoutnae a vonae koehoi kanîloumlah, Ephraim miphunnaw ao awh han. Ephraim catoun kahrawikung teh Ammihud capa Elishama han.
A ransahu teh 40, 500 a pha.
Hahoi Manasseh miphun han. Manasseh catoun kahrawikung teh Pedahzur capa Gamaliel han.
A ransahu teh 32, 200 a pha.
Hahoi Benjamin miphunnaw han. Benjamin catounnaw kahrawikung teh Gideoni capa Abidan han.
A ransahu teh 35, 400 a pha awh.
Ephraim catoun a ransahu a pap e lahoi touk e pueng teh, 108, 100 a pha. Hahoi rekkâbang hanelah a tâco awh han.
A imthungkhu mitnoutnae a vonae koehoi Dannaw teh atunglah ao awh han. Dan catoun kahrawikung teh Ammishaddai capa Ahiezer han.
A ransanaw teh 62, 700 a pha.
Hahoi mitnout ka yap hane teh, Asher miphun han. Asher catoun kahrawikungnaw teh Okran capa Pagiel han.
A ransahu teh 41, 500 a pha awh.
Hahoi Naphtali catounnaw han. Naphtali catounnaw kahrawikung teh Enan capa Ahira han.
Dan miphun ransahu touk e pueng teh 157, 600 a pha awh. Hahoi ahnimouh teh, a huhu lahoi ka tâcawt e a hnukteng poung lah ao awh han.
Hetnaw heh Isarel catoun a na pa e imthungkhu lahoi a touk awh e naw doeh. A ransahu teh a sumkum lah 603, 550 touh a pha.
Hatei BAWIPA ni, Mosi koe kâ a poe e patetlah Levihnaw teh Isarelnaw koe touksin e lah awm hoeh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe kâlawk a poe e patetlah Isarelnaw ni a sak awh. Amamae ahu kâbang lahoi a roe awh. Hot patetlah a miphun lahoi imthung ao awh e patetlah a tâco awh.
\s1 Aron catounnaw hoi Levih
Hetnaw heh, Sinai mon koehoi BAWIPA ni Mosi a pato navah, Aron hoi Mosi se nah a thut e doeh.
Aron capanaw e a min teh, camin lah Nadab. Hahoi Abihu Eleazar hoi Ithamar doeh.
Hetnaw heh vaihma hanlah satui awi e, vaihma thaw tawk hanlah hmoun e, Aron e capanaw e min doeh.

Nadap hoi Abihu teh Sinai kahrawngum vah kathounghoehe hmai, BAWIPA hmalah thuengnae a sak roi navah, BAWIPA hmalah a due roi, ahnimouh roi teh capa tawn roi hoeh. Eleazar hoi Ithamar teh a na pa a hring navah vaihma thaw a tawk roi.
BAWIPA ni Mosi a pato teh,
Levih miphun teh vaihma Aron koe cetkhai nateh, a thaw a tawk thai nahan, ahni koe awm naseh.
Ahnimouh ni lukkareiim dawk thaw a tawk awh vaiteh, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim hmalah ama hoi kamkhuengnaw ni panki e patetlah thaw a tawk awh han.
Hnopai pueng a khetyawt awh vaiteh, Isarel catounnaw ni a ham kawi e lah lukkareiim dawk thaw a tawk awh han.
Levihnaw teh Aron hoi a capanaw koevah, na poe awh vaiteh, Isarel catounnaw thung hoi ahnimouh hah na rawi awh vaiteh, kai koe ahnimouh na poe awh han.

Aron hoi a capanaw hah na pouk vaiteh, vaihma coungnae hah pou a pang awh han. Ahnimouh koe miphun louk bawk pawiteh, thei lah ao han, telah a ti.   
\s1 Levihnaw milu touk hanelah kâ a poe
BAWIPA ni Mosi a pato teh,
khenhaw! Levihnaw heh Isarel catounnaw thung hoi camin camoim hmaloe ka paawng hanelah kai kama roeroe ni Isarel catounnaw thung hoi ka lae lah ao teh, Levihnaw teh kaie lah ao awh han.

Bangkongtetpawiteh, caminnaw pueng teh kaie lah ao han. Izip ram vah caminnaw pueng ka thei navah, Isarelnaw pueng teh camin hoi tami hoi moithang hoi kai kama hanelah ka thoung sak e lah ao. Kai teh Jehovah doeh telah atipouh.
BAWIPA ni Sinai kahrawngum vah, Mosi hah a pato teh,
Levih catounnaw hah a na pa imthung lahoi tongpa pueng thapa yung touh lathueng pueng teh koung na touk han atipouh.
Hot patetlah Mosi koe kâ a poe e BAWIPA lawk patetlah koung a touk pouh.
Levih catounnaw e min teh Gershon, Kohath, hoi Merari naw doeh.
Gershon catoun imthungnaw e teh, Libni hoi Shimei doeh.
Kohath catoun imthungnaw e teh Amram, Izhar, Hebron hoi Uziel doeh.
Merari catoun imthungnaw teh, Mahli hoi Mushi doeh. Hetnaw heh a na pa imthung lahoi Levih catounnaw doeh.
Gershon teh Libni imthung hoi Shimei imthung kakhekung doeh. Hetnaw heh Gershom catounnaw doeh.
Thapa yung touh hoi lathueng tongpa pueng a touk awh e teh 7500 touh a pha.
Gershon catoun imthungnaw teh lukkareiim a hnuklah kanîloumlah a roe awh han.
Gershonnaw e imthung kahrawikung teh Lael capa Eliasaph han.
Gershon catounnaw thaw teh, lukkareiim lemphu ramuk nahane hoi kamkhuengnae takhang dawk hane yaphni hoi,
thongma takhang dawk hane yaphni hoi khoungroe petkâkalup e hnonaw hoi, hawvah hnonaw pueng a tawk awh hanelah ao han.
Kohath teh Amram imthung, Izhar imthung, Hebron imthung hoi Uziel imthungnaw kakhekung doeh. Hetnaw heh Kohath catounnaw doeh.
Tongpa pueng thapa yung touh hoi lathueng hmuen kathoung ringnae koe tawk hanelah a poe e naw a touk awh navah 8600 a pha.
Kohath catoun imthungnaw teh lukkareiim akalah a roe awh han.
Kohath catoun imthung kahrawikung teh Uziel capa Elizaphan han.
Ahnimae thaw teh, thingkong hoi caboi hoi satui hmaiimkhok hoi, thuengnae hoi, hmuen kathoung koe thaw tawk nahane, hlaamnaw, lukkarei yap e hoi haw e thaw tawknae koe e hnopainaw pueng lah ao han.
Hahoi vaihma Aron capa Eleazar teh Levihnaw kahrawikung a lû lah ao han. Hmuen kathoung karingkungnaw hah a hrawi han.
Merari teh Mahlinaw thung hoi Mushinaw imthung kakhekung lah ao. Hetnaw teh Merari imthungnaw doeh.
Tongpanaw pueng thapa yung touh lathueng a touk awh navah 6200 a pha.
Merari catounnaw e imthung kahrawikung teh Abihail capa Zuriel doeh. Hetnaw teh lukkareiim atunglah a roe awh han.
Merari capa hoi a tawk han kawi lah pouk e teh lukkareiim tapang, pangkhek, khom, a tâphai kepnae, a hnopainaw hoi a thaw tawknae hnopai lah ao awh.
Thongma petkâkalup lah khonaw teh, a kangdue nahane cemnaw pueng hoi a hetsinnae ruinaw hai a sak han.

Hothloilah lukkareiim kanîtholah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim hmalah ka roe e naw teh Mosi, Aron hoi a canaw han. Hmuen kathoung ringnae koe teh Isarel catounnaw a pankinae pueng koe a tawk awh han. Hatei alouke tami rek kahnai e awm pawiteh, thei lah ao han.

BAWIPA kâpoe e lahoi Levihnaw e a catoun tongpanaw thapa yung touh lathueng hoi Aron ni touk e naw teh 22, 000a pha awh.   
\s1 Levihnaw camin ratangnae
BAWIPA ni Mosi koevah, Isarel catounnaw thung dawk camin tongpa thapa yung touh lathueng pueng nâyittouh maw ka phat tie a min lahoi koung touk loe.

Hahoi Levihnaw hah Isarel catoun thung dawk hoi caminnaw yueng lah kai hanelah na la vaiteh, Levihnaw e saring hai, Isarel catounnaw e saring camin pueng e yueng lah kai hanlah na la han. Kai teh Jehovah doeh atipouh.
Mosi teh BAWIPA ni kâ a poe e patetlah Isarel catoun thung dawk caminnaw pueng hah a touk awh
A min phung e lahoi thapa yung touh lathueng tongpa camin pueng a touk awh e teh 22, 273 a pha.
Isarel catoun camin yueng lah Levihnaw hah lat nateh, a saring yueng lah, Levihnaw e saring lat pouh. Levihnaw teh kaie lah ao awh han. Kai teh Jehovah doeh.
Levihnaw hlak vah, bet kapap e Isarel catoun camin 273 ratang nahanelah,
tami buet touh hane hmuen kathoung khingnae tangka patetlah shekel panga touh rip na la awh han. Hmuen kathoung khingnae shekel teh gerah 20 touh a pha.
Ka cawi e ratang nahan hnopai teh Aron hoi a capanaw na poe han telah a ti.
Hahoi Mosi ni Levihnaw ni a ratang awh hoeh e ratangnae hnopai hah a la.
Isarel catoun caminnaw koehoi hnopainaw a la teh hmuen kathoung shekel 1365 a la pouh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi kâ a poe e BAWIPA lawk patetlah Mosi ni a ratangnae hnopai teh Aron hoi a capanaw a poe awh.
\s1 Kohath capanaw e thaw
BAWIPA ni Mosi hoi Aron a pato teh,
Levihnaw thung dawk Kohath capanaw a catoun lahoi a imthung lahoi,
kum 30 lathueng kum 50 totouh kamkhuengnae lukkareiim dawk thaw ka tawk hane naw teh koung a touk awh.
Hete kamkhuengnae lukkareiim dawk kathoungpounge hno hoi kâkuen lah Kohath casaknaw e thaw lah ao.
Roenae koehoi a kampuen awh tangkuem vah, Aron hoi a capa a tho vaiteh, hmuen kathoung lukkareiim yap e hah a la vaiteh lawkpanuesaknae thingkong hah a ramuk han.
Hahoi phaivuen hoi a ramuk vaiteh, kamthim hni hoi bout a ramuk han. Hahoi a tâphai hah a hrawt han.
Caboi dawk kamthim hni a phai vaiteh, tongben, pacen, awi nahane kawlungnaw hoi, vaiyei hruek vaiteh.
Hot teh hni paling a ramuk awh vaiteh, saram pho hoi a ramuk vaiteh, a tâphai a hrawt awh han.
Hmaiimkhok hoi hawvah hno hane hmaiim, paitei hoi paitei tanae manang, satuiumnaw hah kamthim hni hoi a ramuk han.
Hote hno hoi a puengcangnaw teh saram pho hoi ramuk vaiteh kâkayawtnae dawk a tâ han.
Sui khoungroe hah kamthim hni hoi ramuk vaiteh, saram pho hoi a ramuk han. Hahoi a tâphai na hrawt han.
Hmuen kathoung koe thaw tawknae hnonaw pueng hah, koung a la vaiteh, kamthim hni hoi a taoung awh han. Saram pho hoi a ramuk awh han, kâkayawtnae a hrawt awh han.
Khoungroe dawk e hraba hah kathoungcalah kawn vaiteh, avan vah hni paling a phai awh han.
Avan vah thaw a tawknae hlaamnaw pueng, hmaisawinae, cingco, tawkso ka kaw e, maroi, hoi thuengnae khoungroe dawk a ta awh han. Saram pho hoi a ramuk awh vaiteh, a tâphai kâkayawtnae a hrawt awh han.

Hahoi Aron hoi a capanaw ni, a hmuen kathoung poung hoi hmuen kathoung hnopainaw koung a ramuk awh vaiteh, a onae hmuen a kampuen awh nah karawitawi Kohath capa ni kâkayawt hanelah a tho awh han. Hatei kathounge hno hah tek awh mahoeh. Tek awh boipawiteh, a due awh han. Hetnaw heh kamkhuengnae lukkareiim hno, Kohath capanaw ni a tawk awh hane doeh.

Hahoi vaihma Aron capa Eleazar capa a tawk hane kawi teh, paang hane satui hoi hmuitui pout laipalah, tavai poenae, awi e satui hoi lukkareiim thung kaawm e hnonaw pueng, hmuen kathoung hoi hnopainaw ring hanelah ao telah a ti.
BAWIPA ni Mosi hoi Aron a pato teh,
Kohath catoun imthungnaw hah Levihnaw thung dawk hoi kahmat sak hanh.

Hatei kathoungpounge hno hah ouk a hnai toteh, dout laipalah a hring awh nahan, hot hoi kâkuen lah het heh sak loe. Aron hoi a capa hah a kâen vaiteh, a tawk awh hane thaw hah amamouh lengkaleng pouk pouh naseh.

Hatei, kathoungpounge hno khet hanlah dongdeng hai kâen hanh awh. Hoehpawiteh a due awh han telah atipouh.   
\s1 Gershon capanaw e thaw
Gershon capanaw hoi a imthungkhu a catounnaw abuemlah koung a touk awh.
kum 30 hoi a lathueng a lathueng kum 50 totouh, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim koe thaw ka tawk hane naw hah koung a touk awh.
Gershon catounnaw a tawk awh hanelah a kamngai awh e teh,
Lukkareiim dawk lukkarei yap e, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang koe hni yap e hah,
Kalupnae hni yap e, kalupnae longkha koe yap e, bawknae rim thuengnae khoungroe teng kaawm e, arui hoi a hnopainaw pueng a phu awh vaiteh, tawksak a ngai e pueng a tawk awh han.
Gershon capanaw a tawk awh nah tangkuem koe Aron hoi a capanaw ni thaw a poe awh e patetlah a tawk awh han.
Hetheh, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim Gershon capa imthungnaw e thaw a tho. Ahnimae thaw hah, vaihma Aron capa Ithamar kâtawnae rahim ao awh han.
Merari capanaw kong dawk a catounnaw abuemlahoi imthungkhu lahoi koung na touk a han.
Kum 30 hoi a lathueng lah kum 50 totouh kamkhuengnae lukkareiim dawk thaw a tawk awh hanelah ka kâen hane pueng na touk awh han.
Kamkhuengnae lukkareiim dawk, ka ceitakhai han naw e thaw teh, hethah doeh. Bawknae im tapang, thing a tâphai hai, a khom, a kanâ,
thongma tumdumnae khom, a kanâ, cem, hoi ruinaw, hote hnopainaw pueng hoi alouke hnonaw kâkayawt hanelah, a min lahoi amamae ham na pouk pouh han.

Hetheh vaihma Aron capa Ithamar kâtawnnae rahim vah, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim hanelah Merari capa imthungnaw niyah a sak awh hane thaw la doeh ao telah atipouh.   
\s1 Levihnaw touknae
Hahoi Mosi hoi Aron hoi tamimaya kahrawikungnaw ni Kohath capa a catoun abuemlahoi imthung abuemlahoi,
kamkhuengnae lukkareiim dawk a tawk awh hane hah kum 30 touh hoi a lathueng lah kum 50 totouh a touk awh.
A catoun abuemlahoi a touk awh e teh, 2, 750 a pha.

\s1 Thoungsaknae kâlawk

Mosi hoi Aron teh tamimaya koehoi kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang koe a cei roi teh, a tabo roi. Hahoi ahnimouh roi koe BAWIPA bawilennae a kamnue.
BAWIPA ni Mosi a pato teh,

sonron lat nateh, nang hoi na hmau Aron ni taminaw pâkhueng awh. Ahnimae mithmu vah lungsongpui koe lawk dei pouh. Tui a tâcosak han. Hot patetlah hoiyah, lungsongpui dawk hoi tui na tâcosak vaiteh, taminaw pueng hoi saringnaw hah na nei sak han telah ati.

Mosi hoi Aron ni taminaw pueng hah lungsongpui teng a pâkhueng teh, ahnimouh koe, taran ouk ka thaw e taminaw, atu thai awh haw! hete lungsong dawk hoi nangmouh han tui ka tâcosak roeroe han maw telah atipouh.
Hahoi teh Mosi ni a kut a dâw teh, a sonron hoi lungsongpui hah vai hni touh a hem, hat toteh, tui kapap poung lah a tâco. Taminaw pueng hoi saringnaw ni a nei awh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi hoi Aron koe kai na yuem hoeh teh, Isarel catounnaw mithmu vah, kai na barilawa hoeh dawkvah, hete taminaw pueng teh kai ni na poe awh e ram dawk na kâenkhai mahoeh, telah atipouh.

Isarel catounnaw ni BAWIPA rek a cusin awh teh ahnimouh thung vah ama barilawa hanlah ao dawk hote tui teh Meribah ati awh.   
\s1 Edom ni a ngang
Hahoi Mosi ni Kadesh hoi Edom siangpahrang koevah, patounenaw a patoun. Na hmaunawngha Isarel ni hettelah a dei. Maimouh koe ka phat e runae kathonaw pueng,
mintoenaw Izip ram a cei awh teh, moikasaw lah Izip ram vah ka o awh teh, Izipnaw ni kai koe hoi mintoenaw totouh rucatnae na poe e hah na panue.
BAWIPA koe ka hram awh e lawk hah a thai teh, kalvantaminaw a patoun teh, Izip ram hoi na tâco sak. Khenhaw, na ram hoi ka hnai poung lah, Kadesh khopui dawkvah ka o awh.

Pahren lahoi na ram thung pou na rakan sak haw. Law thoseh, misur takha thoseh, ka coungroe awh mahoeh. tuikhu dawk e tui hai ka net mahoeh. Siangpahrang lamthungpui dawk doeh ka cei awh han, na ram ka tapoung hoeh roukrak avoilah aranglah hai kampuen awh mahoeh, telah ati.
Edom ni kai ka ram dawk na cet awh mahoeh, telah hoehpawiteh, nangmouh tuk hanelah tahloi hoi kamthaw awh han, telah ati.

Isarel catounnaw ni lamthungpui dawk hoi ka cei awh vaiteh kamamouh hoi ka saringnaw ni na tui ka net awh pawiteh, aphu na poe awh han, hno alouke banghai sak laipalah, raka lah doeh pou ka raka awh ti telah atipouh awh.

Hot patetlah Isarel catounnaw teh Edom ni a ram dawk dei hanlah pasoung awh hoeh. Hahoi Isarel teh ahnimouh koehoi a kamlang takhai awh.   
\s1 Aron duenae

Taminaw pueng ni Aron a due tie a thai awh toteh, Isarelnaw pueng ni Aron teh hnin 30 touh a khui awh.
\s1 Hormah vah Kanaannaw tânae
Kanaannaw Arad siangpahrang akalae kaawm e niyah, Isarelnaw, Atharim lam koe lah a tho awh ti a thai awh toteh, Isarelnaw hah a tuk awh teh, a tangawn san lah a man awh.
Hottelah Isarelnaw ni BAWIPA koevah lawk a kam awh teh, hetnaw heh kaimouh kut dawk na poe pawiteh, a khopui hah peng ka raphoe thai han telah ati awh.

BAWIPA ni Isarelnaw e lawk a tarawi pouh teh, Kanaannaw teh a kut dawk poe lah ao. Amamouh hoi a khopuinaw hah he a raphoe teh, hote hmuen teh Hormah telah ati awh.   
\s1 Rahum tahrun
Hor mon koehoi tuipui paling koelah Edom ram lawngven lahoi a cei awh. Lam ekvoi a kâhei awh dawkvah, taminaw pueng teh a lungkuep laipalah,

Cathut hoi Mosi taranlahoi kahrawngum vah due hanelah bangkongmaw Izip ram hoi na tâcokhai. Vaiyei hai awm hoeh, tui hai awm hoeh, hete vaiyei karawcap e hai ka hringnae ni a panuet toe, telah ati awh.
Hatdawkvah, BAWIPA ni hmai tahrun a thasin teh, taminaw a khue dawkvah moikapap a due awh.
Hatnavah taminaw ni Mosi koe a tho awh teh, BAWIPA hoi nang koe taranlahoi lawk ka dei e hah ka yon awh toe. Tahrunnaw hah kaimouh koehoi takhoe hanlah BAWIPA koe na kâhet pouh leih, telah atipouh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe hmai tahrun hah sak nah teh khom dawk hoi pathout pouh. Tahrun ni a khue e pueng ni hote hah a khet vaiteh a hring awh han telah atipouh.

Hahoi Mosi ni rahum tahrun hah a sak teh, khom dawk a vo. Hahoi teh tahrun ni a khue e pueng rahum tahrun hah a khet awh teh a dam awh.   
\s1 Hormon koehoi Moab vah

Hatdawkvah, BAWIPA tarantuknae cauk dawk, Suphat hoi Vaheb Arnon, Arnon sawkcanaw hoi.
Ar kho lahoi ka lawng e sawkcanaw hai, Moab ramri lahoi a teng poe ka lawng e telah a dei awh.
Hahoi, Beer lah a cei awh. Haw teh BAWIPA ni Mosi koevah, taminaw pueng hah kaw nateh, tui ka poe han ati nae tuikhu koe doeh.

Kahrawikungnaw a bonae tuikhu hah kâlawk kapoekung sonron hoi tai e, miphunnaw kahrawikung ni a tai e, ti hoiyah, hote kahrawng koehoi Mattanah lah a cei awh.

\s1 Siangpahrang Sihon tânae
Isarelnaw ni Amornaw e siangpahrang Sihon koevah, na ram dawk hoi kaimouh na rakan sak haw. Na law dawk thoseh, misur takha dawk thoseh, ka cet awh mahoeh. Na tuikhu dawk e tui hai ka net awh mahoeh.
Na ram ka tapoung hoeh roukrak, siangpahrang lamthungpui dawk doeh ka cet awh ti telah patounenaw a patoun.

Hatei, Sihon ni a ram dawk rakan sak hane pasoung hoeh. Hottelah Sihon ni a taminaw pueng a pâkhueng teh, Isarelnaw tuk hanlah kahrawngum a kamthaw awh. Jahaz vah a pha awh teh Isarelnaw hah a tuk awh.
Isarelnaw ni, kahran e tahloi hoi a tuk awh van teh a ram teh Arnon hoi Jabbok totouh, Ammon catounnaw ram totouh a la pouh awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Ammonnaw e ramri teh pou a patoup awh e doeh.
Isarelnaw ni khonaw pueng koung a la awh. Hottelah Isarelnaw teh, Ammonnaw e khonaw pueng dawk Heshbon hoi khotenaw pueng dawk kho a sak awh.
Heshbon kho teh Ammornaw e siangpahrang Sihon onae kho doeh. Ahni teh Moab siangpahrang hoi taran a kâtuk teh a kut dawk e a ram naw pueng Arnon palang kalatkung doeh.
Hatdawkvah, la ka phuengkung ni, Heshbon vah tho loe, Sihon khopui teh bout thawng awh sei, bout pathoup awh sei.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Heshbon hoi hmai a tâco teh, Sihon khopui hoi hmai a to. Moab khopui Ar kho koung a kak. Arnon hmuenrasang bawinaw hoi,
Oe Moab na yawthoe, nang teh na kahma toe. Khemosh taminaw, Amornaw e siangpahrang koevah, a capanaw yawngkhai hane hoi, a canunaw a san lah a poe awh.
Hatei, kai ni na tâ awh toe. Heshbon teh Dibon totouh a kahma. Hottelah Nophah kho totouh a raphoe teh, hot ni teh Medeba totouh a pha.
Hot patetlah Amornaw e ram koe Isarelnaw teh kho a sak awh.
Hahoi Mosi ni Jazer tuet hanlah tami a patoun. Hote kho a la teh, haw vah kaawm e Amor taminaw a pâlei awh.
A ban awh teh, Bashan lam koe lah a takhang awh. Bashan siangpahrang Og teh ahnimouh tuk hanelah ama hoi a taminaw pueng hoi Edrei hoi tuk hanelah a kamthaw awh.

BAWIPA ni Mosi koevah ahni teh taket hanh loe. Ama hoi a taminaw khuehoi a ram totouh na kut dawk na poe toe. Heshbon e kaawm e Amornaw e siangpahrang Sihon koevah na sak e patetlah na sak han telah atipouh.
Hahoi teh ama thoseh, a capanaw thoseh, buet touh boehai pâhlung laipalah a taminaw pueng hoi a thei awh teh a ram teh hmawi a tawn pouh awh.
\s1 Balak ni Balaam a coun
Isarel catounnaw teh pou a cei awh teh, Jeriko kho namran lah Jordan palang na ran Moab tanghling dawk a roe awh.
Zippor capa Balak ni Isarelnaw ni Amornaw lathueng a sak e naw pueng a thai.
Tamimaya hah apap poung dawkvah, Moab ni taki lah a taki katang. Isarelnaw kecu dawk Moab teh kângairu lah ao.

Hottelah Moab ni Midian a lungkahanaw koe Maito ni hram koung a ai e patetlah hete taminaw ni kaimae tengpam e taminaw pueng koung a i han doeh telah ati. Hote tueng navah Zippor capa Balak teh Moab siangpahrang lah ao.

Ahni ni khenhaw! miphun buet touh Izip ram hoi ka tâcawt e ao teh, talai dawk muen a kawi awh. Kaimouh rahak vah sut ao awh. Pahren lahoi tho nateh hetnaw heh thoebo haw. Bangkongtetpawiteh kai hane teh a thasaipoung awh.

Ahnimanaw tâ vaiteh ram dawk hoi ka pâlei thai yawkaw han kai ma. Bangkongtetpawiteh, yawhawi na poe e teh yawhawi e lah ao, thoe na bo e pueng teh thoebo lah ao tie ka panue, telah kaw hanelah na catounnaw a onae ram, palang teng vah, Pethor e Beor capa Balaam koevah patounenaw a patoun.
Hatdawkvah, Moab a lungkahanaw hoi Midian a lungkahanaw teh thoebo sak phu poe hanelah tadawnghno sin hoi a cei awh teh, Balaam koe a pha awh. Balak ni lawkthui e hah a dei pouh awh.
Ahni ni, atu tangmin lah teh awi hi vah roe awh. BAWIPA ni na dei pouh e patetlah nangmouh koe lawk na thui awh han telah atipouh. Hottelah, Moab tami kalennaw teh Balaam koe a roe awh.
Balaam koe Cathut a tho teh nang koe kaawm e taminaw heh bangpatetnaw maw, telah atipouh.
Balaam ni Cathut koevah, Zippor capa Moab siangpahrang Balak ni kai koevah,
khenhaw! Izip ram hoi ka tho e miphun ni talai dawk muen a kawi awh. Ahnimouh ka tâ vaiteh, ka pâlei thai nahanelah thoe na bo pouh haw, a titeh, taminaw a patoun e doeh telah atipouh.
Cathut ni Balaam koevah, ahnimouh koe cet hanh, hotnaw teh thoe hai bo hanh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, ahnimouh teh yawkahawi e tami doeh, telah atipouh.
Balaam teh amom a thaw teh Balak e tamikalennaw koe, na ram lah ban awh leih, bangkongtetpawiteh, BAWIPA ni nangmouh koe cei hanlah na pasoung hoeh telah ati.
Moab tamikalennaw teh, a thaw awh teh Balak koevah a cei awh. Ahni koe Balaam ni maimouh koe kâbang ngai hoeh atipouh.
Balak ni ahnimouh hlak kapap, ahnimouh hlak minhmai khet kaawm, tamikalennaw hah bout a patoun.
Balaam koevah, a pha awh teh, Zippor capa Balak ni telah ati, kai koe na kâbang hane bang ni hai na ngang hanh naseh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, barilawa kaawm lah na tawm katang han, kai koe na dei e pueng ka sak han, hatdawkvah, tho nateh hetnaw heh thoe na bo pouh haw ati telah ati.
Balaam ni Balak e sannaw hah a pathung teh ahnimouh koe Balak ni a im hoi athung vah sui ngun khakkawi lah na poe han nakunghai, BAWIPA ka Cathut lawk hloilah banghai ka sak thai hoeh.
Hatdawkvah, BAWIPA ni kai koe bangmaw bout a dei han, atu tangmin teh hi roe awh ei telah atipouh.
Hat hnin tangmin vah Balaam koe Cathut a tho teh, ahnimouh koe, hetnaw heh nang na kaw hanlah tho pawiteh, thaw nateh ahnimouh koe kâbang. Hatei nang koe ka dei e dueng na sak han, telah atipouh.

Balaam teh amom vah a thaw teh, la hah a rakueng, Moab tamikalennaw koevah a kâbang.   
\s1 Balaam e la hoi kalvan tami
Hottelah, a cei kecu dawkvah, Cathut lungkhueknae a kaman teh, BAWIPA kalvantami teh ama ngang hanelah lam dawk sut a kangdue. Ama teh la dawk kâcui niteh, a san kahni touh hoi haw vah ao.
La ni BAWIPA kalvantami ni tahloi patuep hoi lam dawk a kangdue e hah a hmu teh, lam a phen teh kahrawng lahoi a cei. Hottelah Balaam ni la teh lam dawk ban hanelah a hem.
BAWIPA kalvantami teh misur takha hoi takha rahak e lam koe bout a kangdue.
La ni BAWIPA kalvantami hah bout a hmu toteh, misur takha rai lah a kâhnawn dawkvah, Balaam khok pak a kuen. Balaam ni bout a hemkhai.
BAWIPA kalvantami ni teh, a hmalah rek bout a cusin teh avoilah, aranglah kamheithaihoehnae lamceknae koe a kangdue pouh.
La ni, BAWIPA kalvantami hah a hmu teh Balaam teh rawk a tabo khai. Hahoi, Balaam a lungkhuek teh, a sonron hoi la teh a hem.
BAWIPA ni la hah a lawk a thosak. Balaam koevah nang na tak dawk bangmaw ka sak, vai thum touh totouh kai na hemkhai telah atipouh.
Balaam ni la koevah, nang ni kai na noutna hoeh teyaw, tahloi ka sin nah pawiteh, na thei han ei nan maw atipouh.
La ni Balaam koevah, sahnin totouh na kâcui e la nahoehmaw. Hettelah nang koe ouk ka sak boimaw, telah ati. Ahni ni na sak boihoeh bokheiyah telah atipouh.
BAWIPA ni Balaam mit hah a ang sak teh, BAWIPA kalvantami tahloi hoi lam dawk sut a kangdue e hah a hmu. A saling teh talai dawk minhmai rek kâbet lah a tabo.
BAWIPA kalvantami ni ahni koe, bangkongmaw, vai thum totouh la na hem. Khenhaw! na cei hoeh nahan koelah na cei kecu dawkvah, nang ngang hanlah ka tâco.
La ni na hmu teh ka hmalah vai thum touh na roun. Na roun hoehpawiteh, la teh thet hoeh vaiteh, nang nama nouh thei lah na awm ei ti heh ma, telah atipouh.
Balaam ni BAWIPA kalvantami koevah, ka yon toe, bangkongtetpawiteh, kai taranlahoi lam na kangdue tie ka panuek hoeh, hatdawkvah na lunghawihoeh pawiteh ka ban han telah atipouh.
BAWIPA e kalvantami ni Balaam koevah, hetnaw koe vah cet, hateiteh, nang koe ka dei e dueng ahnimouh koe na dei pouh han telah atipouh. Hahoi teh, Balaam teh Balak e tami kalennaw koe a cei.
Balak ni Balaam a tho tie hah a panue toteh, Arnon koelae ramri Moab khopui totouh a dawn awh.
Balak ni Balaam koevah, atangcalah nang la hanlah tami ka patoun nahoehmaw. Bangkongmaw kai koe na tho ngai hoeh. Tamikalen poung lah na coung sak thai mahoeh maw, telah atipouh.
Balaam ni Balak koevah, khenhaw! nang koe vah ka tho toe. Bang hno pueng deithainae kâ ka tawn na maw. Cathut ni ka pahni dawk a ta e dueng doeh ka dei tih, telah ati.
Balak ni maito hoi tu hoi thuengnae a sak. Balaam hoi ama koe kaawm e tamikalennaw koe youn touh a poe.
Hahoi a tangtho vah, Balak ni Balaam a hrawi teh, tamimaya hah pâtue hanelah, Baal hmuenrasang koe a luenkhai.
\s1 Apasuek lawk deinae
Hahoi, Balaam ni Balak koevah, hivah thuengnae khoungroe sari touh na sak pouh loe. Maitotan sari touh, tutan sari touh kai hanlah na rakueng pouh loe telah a ti.
Balak ni Balaam dei e patetlah a sak. Balak hoi Balaam ni bawknae khoungroe tangkuem vah, maitotan buet touh hoi tutan buet touh a poe awh.

Balaam ni Balak koevah, nang ni hmaisawi thuengnae teng vah, pou kangdout lah a, kai teh alouk lah yo ka cet eivai, BAWIPA ni kai pato hanlah a tho thai, hahoi na dei pouh e pueng kai ni nang koe na dei pouh han telah atipouh. Hahoi kacailum e hmuenrasang koe a cei.
Cathut ni Balaam a kâhmo teh ahnimouh ni ama koe bawknae khoungroe sari touh ka sak toe. Bawknae khoungroe buet touh dawk maitotan buet touh, tutan buet touh rip ka poe toe telah a ti.
Hottelah BAWIPA ni Balaam koe pahni dawk lawk hah a ta pouh teh, ahni koe Balak koe ban nateh, hettelah patuen dei pouh telah a ti.
Hahoi ahnimouh a ban teh, khenhaw, hmaisawinae a kung koe ama hoi Moab tami kalennaw teh pou a kangdue teh,
ahni ni lawk hah a pâpho pouh teh, a ram lahoi Balak ni a ceikhai teh, Kanîtholae mon Moab siangpahrang ni tho haw, Jakop hah thoebo haw, tho haw, Isarel hah na pathoe pouh haw telah a ti.
Bangtelamaw, Cathut ni thoebo hoeh e thoe louk ka bo han, bangtelamaw, Cathut ni pathoe hoeh e louk ka pathoe han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, lungsongpui dawk ahnimouh teh ka hmu teh, monpui dawk hoi ahnimouh teh ka khet. Khenhaw! miphun louk lah doeh ao awh. Jentelnaw koe pareisin hanlah awm hoeh.
Jakop vaiphu teh apinimaw a touk thai han. Isarel pung pali pung touh teh apinimaw a touk thai han. Tamikalan due e patetlah dout van boipawiteh, ka poutnae teh a poutnae lah thoseh, telah a ti.
Balak ni Balaam koevah, na sak e teh bangtelae na maw. Ka tarannaw thoebo hanlah na hrawi teh, yawhawi dai na poe atipouh.

Ahni ni BAWIPA ni ka pahni dawk a ta e lawk ka dei mahoeh na maw telah atipouh.   
\s1 Apâhni lawk bout deinae
Balak ni alouklah cet ei, haw hoi teh na hmu thai nahanlah a onae hmuen ram pueng be na hmu han, abuemlahoi teh be na hmawt mahoeh ei, hot hmuen koehoi ahnimouh teh thoe na bo pouh han telah a ti.
Hottelah, Zophimnaw onae Pisgah monsom dawk a luenkhai. Thuengnae khoungroe sari touh a sak teh, hote thuengnae khoungroe tangkuem dawk maitotan buet touh hoi tutan buet touh rip a poe.
Balak koevah, hawvah, BAWIPA ka kâhmo navah, hmaisawi thuengnae a kung koe pou ka kangdout loe telah atipouh.
BAWIPA ni Balaam a kâhmo teh a pahni dawk lawk a ta pouh. Balak koe ban nateh hettelah patuen dei pouh telah a ti.
Ahni koe a cei sin teh, khenhaw! hmaisawi thuengnae akung koevah, a kangdue teh, Moab tami kalennaw hai ahni koe ao. Balak ni BAWIPA ni bangtelamaw a dei telah a ti.
Hahoi teh ahni ni lawk hah a pâpho teh, thaw haw, Balak ka lawk thai haw, Zippor capa ka lawk hah thai haw.
Cathut teh laithoe ka dei e tami nahoeh. Pankângai e tami capa lahai tho hoeh. A dei e teh sak mahoeh na maw. A dei tangcoung e hah kuep sak mahoeh na maw.
Khenhaw! yawhawi poe hanelah kâlawk ka hmu teh, a yaw ahawi sak toung dawkvah, kâthung thai mahoeh toe.
Jakop koe payonpakainae hmawt hoeh niteh, Isarel hawihoehnae hmawt hoeh. Jehovah a Cathut ni a okhai teh, siangpahrang hramnae lawk ahnimouh koe ao.

Mosi ni ahnimouh koe Gad canaw hoi Reuben canaw tarantuknae puengcang kâmahrawk e pueng ni, BAWIPA hmalah Jordan tui a rakakhai han. Ram teh na la hnukkhu, Gilead ram teh a coe awh hanlah na poe awh han.
Hatei puengcang kâmahrawk hoi na cetkhai awh hoehpawiteh, Kanaan ram vah nangmouh koe a bawk van han telah ati.
Hahoi Gad canaw hoi Reuben canaw ni na sannaw koevah, BAWIPA ni a dei e patetlah ka sak han.
Puengcang kâmahrawk hoi BAWIPA hmalah, Kanaan ram takhang vaiteh kâen awh han. Hatei, coe awh hane ram teh, Jordan namran lah doeh pou coe awh ti telah a pathung awh.

Mosi ni Gad catounnaw hoi Reuben catounnaw hah Joseph capa Manasseh miphun tangawn teh, Amor siangpahrang Sihon uknaeram hoi Bashan siangpahrang, Og uknaeram kaawm e khonaw pueng hoi, a tengpam khotenaw pueng hoi koung a poe awh.
Aroth-shonphan, Jazer hoi Jobehah,
Bethnimrah hoi Bethharan kho a thawng awh teh, rapan ka tawn e khopui hoi tu imnaw a sak awh.
Reuben catounnaw ni Heshbon, Elealeh hoi Kiriathaim,
Nebo, Baalmeon, Sibmah hah a thawng awh. Hote kho a thawng awh e hah min louk lah a phung awh
Manasseh capa Makhir catounnaw teh Gilead ram a cei awh teh a la awh. Amornaw haw kaawm pueng teh be a lawp awh.
Hatdawkvah, Mosi ni Gilead ram teh Manasseh capa Makhir koe a poe teh hawvah khosak awh.
Manasseh capa Jair ni a cei teh khotenaw hah a la dawkvah, hotnaw hah Jair telah a phung awh.
Nobah hai a cei teh, Kenath khotenaw a la teh, a min lah Nabah telah a phung awh.
\s1 Izip ram hoi Isarelnaw kahlawng ceinae
Hetnaw heh Mosi hoi Aron ni hrawi e lahoi IZip ram hoi ahuhu lahoi a tâco awh teh, a ceinae doeh.
BAWIPA ni kâ poe e patetlah a tâco pasuek hoiyah, a ceinae naw hah Mosi ni koung a thut. Hetheh kahlawng cei a kamtawngnae koehoi pou a deinae doeh.
Thapa ayung pasuek, hnin hlaipanga hin vah Raameses hoi a tâco awh teh ceitakhai pawi hnin a tangtho amom vah Izipnaw e mithmu vah,
a caminnaw pueng BAWIPA ni a thei pouh e naw a pakawp awh lahun nah, Isarel catounnaw pueng lungtang lahoi a tâco awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, BAWIPA ni ahnimae cathut koehai lawk a ceng teh a rek pouh.

Pihahiroth hoi a tâco awh teh talî tapoung hoi kahrawngum vah a kâen awh. Hahoi Etham kahrawng dawk hnin thum touh a cei awh teh, Marah vah a roe awh.
Marah hoi a cei awh teh, Elim lah a pha awh. Haw vah tuiphuek hlaikahni touh hoi ungkung 70 touh ao teh haw vah a roe awh.

Rephidim koehoi a cei awh teh, Sinai kahrawngum vah a roe awh.
Sinai kahrawngum koehoi a cei awh teh, Kiborthhattaavah vah a roe awh.

\s1 Kanaan tâ nahanelah hmusaknae
Hahoi Jeriko tengpam Jordan palang teng Moab tanghling dawk BAWIPA ni Mosi hah a pato teh,
Isarel catounnaw hah pato nateh, ahnimouh koe Jordan tui na raka awh teh, Kanaan ram na kâen awh toteh,
hote ram dawk kaawmnaw pueng be na pâlei awh han. Ahnimae talung meikaphawknaw pueng be na raphoe pouh han, hmuenrasang hai be na raphoe pouh han.
Hahoi ram teh na coe awh vaiteh, hawvah kho na sak awh han, bangkongtetpawiteh, na coe hane ram teh na poe toe.

Hahoi a ma miphun lahoi cungpam na rayu awh vaiteh, ram teh na coe awh vaiteh, na kârei awh han, bet kapap e hah ram kakawhnawn na poe awh han. Kayoun e hah kabuenghnawn lah na poe awh han. Cungpam na rayu awh e patetlah kâvan lah na ham awh han. Na mintoenaw e phung patetlah na coe awh han.
Hatei, hote ram dawk kaawmnaw hah na pâlei awh hoeh e naw teh, na mit dawk mittanuen hoi na tak dawk pâkhing kaawm vaiteh, na onae ram dawk runae na poe awh han.
Hothloilah, ahnimouh koe sak han ka noe e hah namamouh koe letlang ka sak han tet pouh telah a ti.
\s1 Kanaan ramri khuennae
BAWIPA ni Mosi hah a pato teh,
Isarelnaw hah lawkthui nateh, hetheh Kanaan ram na pha awh toteh nangmouh ni na pang awh hane Kanaan ramri doeh atipouh.
Akalah nangmae khori teh, Zin kahrawngum hoi Edom ram yunglam han, akalae khori teh palawi talî apoutnae koehoi Kanîtholae han.
Hahoi nangmae ramri teh, Akrabbim takhangnae a rahim hoi a lawngven vaiteh, Zin pou a rakan vaiteh, Kadeshbarnea a rahim totouh han, hahoi Hazaraddar lah cet vaiteh, Azmon vah pou a cei tâphai han.
Hote ramri teh Azmon Izip palang totouh lawngven vaiteh, tuipuipaling koe a pout han.
Kanîloumlah, tuipui hah khori lah na coe awh han, hetheh kanîloumlae na ramri lah ao han.
Hahoi hetheh atunglae na khori lah ao han, tuipui koehoi Hor mon pâum lahoi na sak han.
Hor mon koehoi Hamath kâennae koe totouh na sak awh han, haw hoi khori a tâconae teh Zedad koe han.
Khori teh, Ziphron pou tapoung vaiteh, Hazarenan vah a pout han, hetheh atunglae na ramri lah ao han.
Hahoi Kanîtholae na khori teh, Hazarenan hoi Shepham totouh na sak awh han.
Na khori teh Shepham hoi Riblah hoi Ain kanîtholah pou a cathuk vaiteh, haw hoi paloupalou cathuk vaiteh, Khinnereth kanîtho talîpui rai koelah a pha han.
Khori teh Jordan lah cathuk vaiteh, palawi talî koe apout han, hetheh na khori lah ao tet pouh telah a ti.
Hahoi teh, Mosi ni Isarelnaw hah kâ a poe teh, hetheh BAWIPA ni miphun tako touh hoi a tangawn poe hanelah, cungpam rayu hoi na coe awh hane ram doeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Reuben miphun catounnaw ni a imthung lahoi, Gad miphun catounnaw ni a imthung lahoi, Manasseh miphun tangawn ni a imthung lahoi a coe awh hane teh be a coe awh toe.

Hete miphun kahni touh hoi tangawn ni a coe awh hane teh, kanîtholah Jeriko tengpam, Jordan palang kanîtholah a coe awh toe telah a ti.   
\s1 Khori ka rei e khobawinaw
hetnaw heh na coe awh hane ram nangmouh rahak vah kareikung min teh vaihma Eleazar hoi Nun capa Joshua doeh.
Hahoi na coe awh hane ram kareikung lah miphun tangkuem dawk hoi khobawi buet touh rip na rawi awh han ati pouh.

A minnaw teh hetnaw hah doeh.  
 Judah catoun dawk hoi Jephunneh capa Kaleb,
Simeoncanaw dawk hoi Ammihud capa Samuel,
Benjaminnaw dawk hoi Khislon capa Elidad,
Dan canaw dawk hoi khobawi Jogli capa Bukki,
Joseph capa Manasseh canaw dawk hoi Ephod capa khobawi Hanniel,
Ephraimcanaw e catoun dawk hoi Shiphtan capa khobawi Kemuel,
Zebuluncanaw dawk hoi Parnach capa khobawi Elizaphan,
Issakharnaw dawk hoi Azzan capa khobawi Azzan,
Asher canaw dawk hoi Shelomi capa khobawi Ahihud,
Naphtalinaw dawk hoi Ammihud capa khobawi Pedahel, han atipouh.
Hetnaw heh Kanaan ram e Isarel catounnaw ram coe hane kareikung lah BAWIPA ni a poe e naw doeh.
\s1 Levihnaw hane khopui
Hahoi Jeriko teng Jordan palang teng vah Moab tanghling dawk BAWIPA ni Mosi hah a pato.
Isarel canaw hah kâpoe leih. A ram thung dawk Levihnaw o nahanlah kho poe awh naseh. Saring a pâ nahanlah kho tengpam hah Levihnaw na poe awh han.
Kho a saknae kho tawn awh vaiteh, a tengpam pueng teh a maito hoi saringnaw a paca awh e a pâ nahanlah awm naseh.
Kho tengpam Levihnaw na poe awh hane teh, kho rapan petkâkalup lah dong 1000 touh akaw han.

Hahoi tumdumnae alawilah hoi na bangnue awh vaiteh, kanîtholah dong 2000, akalah dong 2000, kanîloumlah dong 2000, atunglah dong 2000, alungui kho ao han. Hetnaw heh a ham awh e khopuinaw rapan alawilah han.
Levihnaw na poe awh hane khonaw thung dawkvah, tamikathetnaw a yawng nahane taruk touh na rawi awh han. Hothloilah kho 42 touh na thapsin han.
Levihnaw na poe hane khonaw pueng teh, a ram hoi kho 48 touh a pha han.

Isarelnaw khosak nahan na poe e teh, kapap hah kapap na poe vaiteh, kayoun hah kayoun na poe han. Tami pueng ni a coe awh e ram apap e patetlah Levihnaw kho na poe awh han.   
\s1 Kânguenae khonaw
BAWIPA ni Mosi hah a pato teh,
Isarel canaw hah pato nateh, ahnimouh koe Jordan na raka awh teh, Kanaan ram na kâen toteh,
pouk laipalah tamikathet payon e teh a yawng vaiteh a kângue nahane kho na pouk pouh han.
Tamimaya hmalah lawkceng hanlah a kangdue hoehnahlan, tamikathet payon e teh, ama a due hoeh nahanelah, hote khonaw teh moipathungkung ni a tawng navah a kângue awh nahanelah ao han.
Hottelah, nangmouh hanlah kângue nahane kho na pouk awh hane teh kho 6 touh a pha han.
Jordan namran lah kho kathum touh na pouk awh vaiteh, Kanaan ram lah kho kathum touh na pouk awh han. Kânguenae kho lah ao han.
Isarel catounnaw hoi ahnimouh koe kaawm e imyinnaw hanlah kho 6 touh hah kânguenae kho lah ao han. Awi hawvah, tamikathet payonnaw ni a yawng awh han.
Hatei, sum hoi tami hem boilah dout pawiteh, tamikathet e lah ao dawkvah, tamikathet e teh ama hai roup thei roeroe han.
Hahoi talung hoi tami kadout lah dei pawiteh, ayâ ka thet e lah ao dawkvah, ayâ ka thet e teh ama hai thei roeroe han.
Hahoi tami ni thing hoi tami kadout lah hem pawiteh, ayâ ka thet e lah ao dawkvah, ayâ ka thet e teh ama hai thei roeroe han.
Thiphu moipathungkung ni tami ka thet e teh tang a thei thai han. A hmu boum teh a thei han.
Hahoi tami a hmuhma kecu dawk puenghoi dei tanawt nakunghai thoseh, sut pawp laihoi kadout lah a dêi nakunghai thoseh,
kâoun hoi kut hoi thaw lah koe dout pawiteh, kathetkung hah thei van hane roeroe lah ao. Bangkongtetpawiteh, tamikathetkung doeh. Thipaling moipathungkung ni a hmu nah tangkuem koe a thei han.
Hatei, kâoun kâtai dawk laipalah, a tanawt payon dawk nakunghai thoseh, lam hoi a pawp dawk tho laipalah, tami awm hoeh ti hoi a panue hoehnahlan vah, taran lah hai kaawm hoeh e,
pataw nahan poe hanlah hai kâcai hoeh eiteh, talung hoi koe dêi lah dout payon pawiteh,
tamimaya ni hete lawkcengnae kâlawk patetlah kathetkung hoi thipaling moipathungkung hanlah lawk a ceng awh han.

Hahoi tamimaya ni tamikathetkung hah thipaling moipathungkung koehoi a la ring awh vaiteh, tamimaya ni a yawng nahane kânguenae kho dawk ao sak awh han. Satui kathoung hoi awi e vaihma kacue ka tawk lahun e a due hoehroukrak haw vah ao han.
Hatei, bangpatet e tueng pueng dawk hai tami ka thet e teh, a yawngnae kânguenae kho, khori hloilah cet pawiteh,
thipaling moipathungkung ni kânguenae kho hloilah hmawt boilah thet pawiteh, thipaling dawk yonpennae awm mahoeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, vaihma kacue a due hoehroukrak, kânguenae kho dawk pou o hanlah ao. Vaihma a due hnukkhu, hote tami ka thet e teh ama onae kho dawk a ban han.
Hatei, hnonaw pueng hah na catounnaw totouh na o awh nah tangkuem koe lawkceng e lah ao han.

Tami bangpatet ni nakunghai tami thet pawiteh, tamikathetkung teh kapanuekkhaikung e pahni dawk lawk a tâco sak e lawk lahoi thei lah ao han. Hatei, kapanuekkhaikung buet touh dueng e a pahni dawk e lawk pawiteh, thei khai nahanelah khout hoeh.
Tami kathetkung teh na ratang awh mahoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, due han kamcu totouh yonpen e lah ao toung dawkvah, na thei awh roeroe han.
Kânguenae kho dawk ka yawng e tami teh, hatnae tueng dawk vaihma kacue ka tawk e a due hoehroukrak a onae khoruem dawk bout ban thai nahan, ratang thai mahoeh.
Hatdawkvah, na onae ram na khin sak mahoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, thipaling ni ram hah a khin sak teh, ram a dam nahanlah, thipalawngkung e thipaling hoi dueng doeh yontha thai lah ao.
Hatdawkvah, a lungui e khosaknae na coe awh e ram teh, na khinsak awh mahoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, kai Jehovah teh Isarel catounnaw koe ka o tet pouh telah ati.
Joseph imthung dawk hoi Manasseh capa Makhir capa Gilead catoun imthung kahrawikungnaw hmalah lawk a dei awh.

Ahnimouh ni, BAWIPA ni Isarel catounnaw hah cungpam rayu hoi a coe awh hane ram poe hanlah, ka bawipa Mosi hah kâ a poe teh, hmaunawngha Zelophehad canunaw a coe hane râw hah BAWIPA ni ka bawipa koe kâ a poe toe.

Hatei, ahnimouh ni Isarel catoun thung dawk hoi miphun alouke capa koe vâ sak pawiteh, na mintoenaw e ram a coe awh e hah la pouh vaiteh, a vâ koelae ram miphun koe lah a kâthap han. Hottelah coe tangcoung e ram dawk hoi tâcokhai han.
Hahoi Isarel catounnaw e Jubili a pha toteh, a ram hah a vanaw e miphunnaw ni coe e ram lah thapsin lah ao han. Hottelah mintoenaw e miphun ram thung dawk hoi let na lawp pouh awh han telah ati.
Hatdawkvah, Mosi ni BAWIPA lawk patetlah Isarel catounnaw hah kâ a poe teh, Joseph capa hoi miphunnaw ni a dei e a thuem.
Zelophehad canunaw kong dawkvah BAWIPA ni kâ a poe e teh hettelah doeh. Ahawi ati e pueng vâ naseh, hatei a napanaw e miphun hah vâ awh naseh telah ati.
Hatdawkvah, Isarel catounnaw e ram teh, miphun alouklouk koe voutsout puen laipalah, Isarel catounnaw ni a na mintoenaw e ram teh pou a ham awh han.
Isarel catounnaw thung dawk râw ka pang hane canunaw pueng teh, Isarel catounnaw ni a na mintoenaw e ram lah kaawm e pou a ham thai nahan, a na pa miphun thung e a yu a la hanlah ao.
Ram teh miphun alouklouk koe puen thai mahoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Isarel catounnaw ni amamae ram hah pou a pang awh e lah kaawm han telah a dei.
Hottelah, BAWIPA ni Mosi kâ a poe e patetlah Zelophehad canunaw ni a sak awh van.
Zelophehad canunaw Mahlah, Tirzah hoi Hoglah, Milkah hoi Noah tinaw ni a na pa e hmaunawnghanaw e capanaw hah a vâ awh.
Joseph capa Manasseh e capa hah a vâ awh teh, a ram teh a na pa miphunnaw ni a coe e râw lah pou a kangning.
Hetnaw heh Jeriko tengpam Jordan namran Moab tanghling dawkvah, BAWIPA ni Mosi hno lahoi Isarelnaw koevah, kâ a poe e kâpoelawknaw hoi lawkcengnaenaw doeh.
